test_title: PYST 26: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

All Turquoises are Ochres.

All Ochres are Blues.

Conclusions:

I. No Blues are Turquoises.

II. Some Blues are Turquoises.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/392765a637f6faff7445a492f7e9e03ca727d5ab430d7534f35b3a05ff17f024.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No Blues are Turquoises. - False ( All Turquoises are Ochres.All Ochres are Blues.Some Blue are Turquoises and Hence,No Blues are Turquoises is false).

II. Some Blues are Turquoises. - True ( All Turquoises are Ochres.All Ochres are Blues.Some Blue are Turquoises is True)

Only conclusion (II) follows. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
